newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus Systems raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus Systems raised.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Gunnar Miller said he raised his rating on Novellus Systems Inc to "attractive" from "neutral" following the semiconductor equipment maker's fourth quarter earnings release and an upbeat conference call with management.
-- Miller also raised his estimate of Novellus' 1997 earnings to $4.25 a share from $3.70 a share previously. The company earlier today reported 1996 earnings of $5.70 a share.
-- Miller established a 1998 earnings estimate of $5.55 a share.
-- He set a 12-month target price of 100 for the stock.
